fact: Minister Felix Mutati said government has finalised the Innovation and Inventors Bill, which introduces a Venture Capital Fund for innovators; not stated as tabled or enacted.
The ITU digital innovation profile says Zambia's Ministry of Technology and Science is finalizing a Start-up Bill, on which stakeholders took part in consultations.
The workshop assessed progress on the proposed Startup Bill, per the report.
President Hichilema, in remarks delivered by the Education Minister, referred to Zambia's "soon-to-be-finalized" Startup Bill as a policy framework giving legal direction to innovation.
Minister Felix Mutati announced government will soon table the Innovators and Inventors Bill in Parliament, with provisions for a Venture Capital Fund for young innovators.
